items.title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
items.summary: Researchers have unveiled Frostbite, an innovative CPU architecture that was entirely designed and verified using artificial intelligence. This development could revolutionize how processors are created, potentially leading to more efficient and powerful computing solutions.

items.title: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8)
items.summary: A critical buffer overflow vulnerability has been identified in OpenSSL's EVP_EncodeBlock() function, rated with a CVSS score of 9.8. Developers using OpenSSL should prioritize updating their libraries to mitigate potential security risks.

items.title: Epic Games Turns to AI Coding for the Unreal Engine
items.summary: Epic Games has started integrating AI coding tools into the Unreal Engine to enhance development efficiency and creativity. This move signifies a growing trend of leveraging AI in game development, which could streamline workflows and improve game quality.

items.title: Postgres 19 Repack: Faster, Built-In Table Bloat Cleanup
items.summary: The latest release of Postgres 19 introduces a built-in feature for faster table bloat cleanup, enhancing database performance. This improvement is crucial for developers managing large datasets, as it simplifies maintenance and optimizes resource usage.

items.title: Show HN: Fast deterministic natural language search for OpenStreetMap data
items.summary: A new project has been launched that enables fast and deterministic natural language search capabilities for OpenStreetMap data. This tool can significantly enhance the accessibility and usability of geographic data for developers and researchers.
